rate_optimized_trellis_quantization.conclusion: path freedom is real but finer-lattice symbol complexity more than cancels it under learned coding

two_dimensional_vertical_extension.conclusion: simple bilateral vertical interpolation worsens residual entropy

scientific_takeaway: The remaining hard-Waka gap is not being closed by probability marginalization, generic invertible lifting, finer-lattice trellis selection, or simple deeper spatial interpolation. The strongest reusable fact remains that well-bracketed refinement traces are very cheap (~0.65 bps in the full hierarchy and ~0.606 bps in earlier strict stride-2 tests), while coarse/intermediate state remains the dominant unresolved cost.
